## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 73 captures during February 2023. This represents the total activity reported for the site during the month. The capture volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below.

## Image quality

Of the 73 captures, 3 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.1. These images could not be used for a reliable grading outcome. The result should be monitored as part of routine site operations and image-quality review.

## Grading

Grading identified 12 referable results from the captures completed during February 2023. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This indicates that the typical interval from image capture to a grading decision was 1 day.

The activity, image-quality and grading results should be reviewed together to support ongoing service oversight at Oakridge Primary Care.
